component.name: Quire
component.summary: Notes, day planner and school timetable

description.p: Quire keeps your weekly school timetable, a day planner, homework and exams, and your notes in one place. Everything is stored locally on your computer.

ul.li: Today: a timeline of classes and events, tasks due, and day notes
Week: a colour-coded timetable; open a lesson's notes or add homework from any class
Coursework: homework, assignments, readings and exams grouped by when they are due
Notes: Markdown notes with search, course filing, pinning and autosave
Focus: a Pomodoro timer with breaks, task focus and daily stats

description.p: The first Quire for Android: Today, tasks, notes and sync with your computers.
Quire can run in the background from the system tray and start when you log in.
Quire is now free software under the GPL-3.0-or-later.
Day notes and notes changed on another computer now show up right away.
School: absences with the 25% limit, the Classeviva noticeboard, textbooks and documents, plus a grade trend chart and "what do I need?" for each subject.
Update Quire from inside the app, from its GitHub releases, on Linux and Windows. Also sync between your computers.
Sync between your computers through your own free Firebase project: timetable, tasks, notes, journal, work shifts and focus log. Grades stay on each computer.
Windows: a proper installer with Start menu and uninstall entries.
A new app icon: stitched pages with a bookmark, in Quire's indigo.
Focus on ad-hoc projects: type what you're working on in the Focus timer, and see today's time per task or project.
Reminders: a desktop notification before your next event, work shift or class starts. Internal clean-up of the app's architecture.
A task view to check tasks, all upcoming work on Today, a redesigned task editor, and fixes for saving tasks, backups and imported homework.
Russian translation of the whole interface, with a Language setting.
A Pomodoro focus timer, a Settings dialog, and a choice of currency.
Homework from Classeviva's homework feature, and a Homework & tests list on the School page with overdue work and checkboxes.
Zoomable calendars and a redesigned School page.

ul.li: Fit the whole day on screen, or zoom in and out of Today and Week
School summary tiles: average, next test, homework this week, subjects below 6
Subject rows with recent marks, a trend line and a term filter
Upcoming homework and tests, and lesson topics by day

description.p: More reliable Classeviva sync: each part syncs on its own, failures are shown and never erase existing data, and grades have a fallback source.
Weekly work schedules, repeating shifts and take-home pay.

ul.li: Regular weekly shifts shown next to your school timetable
Repeat shifts every week, every work day or on chosen days
Skip or change a single week's shift
Gross and net pay with per-job tax and deductions
Fixes for entering hourly pay and for Classeviva sync early in the school year

description.p: Classeviva sync, note topics, work shifts and a new look.

ul.li: Homework, tests, grades and lesson topics from Classeviva
Link your own courses to Classeviva subjects
Group notes by class and topic
Work shifts with hours, pay and clash warnings
Sidebar layout with light and dark themes

description.p: First release: day planner, weekly timetable, coursework tracker and Markdown notes.
